scope: Selected-prompt accuracy trace, no performance claim. Observer-enabled generation stops at first mismatch. Cache history is tracked independently; KV values and layouts are captured for same-state replay. Both models resident.

cases.prompt: Some people got on a bus at the terminal. At the first bus stop, half of the people got down and 4 more people got in. Then at the second bus stop, 6 people got down and 8 more got in. If there were a total of 25 people heading to the third stop, how many people got on the bus at the terminal?

probes.note: Same-cache shape controls isolate within-call shape sensitivity; fresh-history controls also change prior arithmetic. A fresh-cache mismatch alone does not prove a cache bug. Schedule, lineage, positions, retained-prefix checks, scores and repeats must be read together.
